         MIN(l.issued_qty, COALESCE(SUM(p.request_qty), 0))

  FROM credit_lots AS l
  LEFT JOIN return_posts AS p ON p.lot_id = l.lot_id AND p.posted_day < '2026-05-01'
  GROUP BY l.lot_id, l.imprint_id, l.unit_cents, l.issued_qty

  "decision-recover-archived-catalogue-join": "WITH RECURSIVE edges(src, dst) AS (
  SELECT from_code, to_code FROM substitution
  UNION

  FROM shelf_entry AS s
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM master_item AS m WHERE m.master_code = s.printed_code)

  SELECT w.entry_id, w.printed_code, e.dst, w.code, w.hops + 1
  FROM walk AS w
  JOIN edges AS e ON e.src = w.code AND e.dst IS NOT w.previous_code
)

                            AND p.end_hour = r.end_hour - 1
                            AND p.meter_run = r.meter_run
                            AND p.meter_items <= r.meter_items
